name: Sunrise Donut & Deli
tagline: OPEN AT FOUR. DONE WHEN THE CASE IS DONE.
address: 12840 Old Frontage Highway, Unit C, next to the tire place, Sprawl Ring 9
about: Sunrise Donut & Deli has been at this address since 1998, first as just Sunrise Donut, then the deli case came in 2004 when my brother-in-law's place over on Vandergrift closed. The donuts are made here starting at 3:15 AM. I am the one who makes them and I am also the one who answers the phone, so please be patient with me on both.
announcement: WE OPEN 4:00 AM EVERY DAY. If you want a specific donut after 10 AM please call first, (555) 214-0087, becuase the case gets thin by then and I don't want you disappointed. Cash is fine at the counter. — Ray

promos.text: Buy 5 drinks, get a stamp. Card printing is paused.

reviews.name: Denise W.
reviews.text: I have been coming here since my kids were small and now they drive themselves here. Ray knows my order, he starts the coffee when he sees the car, and the apple fritter is the size of my hand with the fingers out. The delivery fee is a lot but that is not his fault, that is the app.

reviews.name: Marcus L.
reviews.text: Ordered at 4:20 in the morning and it was already made. Twelve separate trips to the case because I picked every single one, and he still put a napkin stack in the box.

reviews.name: T. Okonkwo
reviews.text: There is nowhere to park. The tire place takes all of it and one of their guys told me to move. I did not even go inside.

reviews.name: Paula R.
reviews.text: The breakfast burrito is wrapped so tight it holds its shape after forty minutes in a car. I do not know how he folds the ends like that.

reviews.name: Greg S.
reviews.text: Called three times about a catering order and got a fax tone twice. Food is good. Phone situation is not.

reviews.name: Anh D.
reviews.text: Old fashioned, coffee with the cream on the side, out the door for under five dollars before the app got involved. It is the last place around here like this.
